attempts.query: Quick Pro GR ONE stiffness ride review
attempts.note: Review reports noticeable designed flex at the seatpost cutout and a comfortable, fast ride; no measured stiffness score.

notes: The site exposes this as qualitative evidence with its basis and does not convert it into a stiffness score or ranking.

resolution.note: The 2025-12-03 review summary describes noticeable flex at the GR:ONE seatpost cutout and a comfortable ride. It does not establish the GRX Di2 build and reports no measured stiffness method/value; retain only as attributed platform-level qualitative feedback.
